steps.note: Open the single-stage configuration screen for the auction setup.
Set the initial auction strategy so the dynamic extension controls can be exercised.

args.goal: In the auction configuration drawer, tick Dynamic Event Extension, leave Extend time by, Trigger time extension on last, and Time extension on change in empty, save, verify Select one of the options appears under both select fields, enter 0.5 as the trigger time and verify Trigger time extension cannot be less than 1 min, verify the same minimum-time error occurs when the trigger time is empty, then switch to Knockout and Dutch Auction strategies and verify the Dynamic Event Extension block is absent; leave the screen showing the validation result.

steps.note: No domain step exposes the dynamic extension fields, their save validation, or strategy-specific block visibility, so perform and observe these interactions directly on the configuration drawer.
